summary: Sandbach United are on the back of a winning performance and heading to Foley FC looking to secure successive victories and a perfect start to the season. Joe Bevan has etched his name into the club's history books with a brace in their last game, taking him past James Kirby's previous record of 54 goals to become the Ramblers' all-time leading scorer in just two seasons. With a full campaign still ahead, Bevan will be hoping to add significantly to his impressive tally.
